newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso closes slightly higher at 1,043.50.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso closes slightly higher at 1,043.50.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed one peso higher at 1,043.50 after a day of what interbank dealers described as quiet and mostly sideways trading.
"There wasn't a lot of real supply or demand (for dollars) and the trading volume was low," one dealer said by telephine.
"The market was so quiet that at one point the bid and ask prices were the same," another added.
Dealers reported 254 trades for a total of $106.7 million and said the peso held in a 1,043.10 to 1,044.65 range.
